invocation.transport: typed JSON intent -> deterministic XML -> vendored MIT ModConfig XSD validation

destructive_actions: overwriting an existing fomod/info.xml or fomod/ModuleConfig.xml at the selected generated package root
human_checks: installer copy and option wording remain presentation choices even when structure validates

coverage.description: Conservative FOMOD 5.0-compatible subset covering metadata, dependencies, required files, install steps/groups/options, flags and conditional installs.
known_gaps: dependency-driven dynamic option typeDescriptor is not yet emitted
mod-manager-specific extensions outside the maintained schema are intentionally excluded
coverage.denominator_probe: all referenced package sources are checked when --package-root is provided; ModuleConfig must validate against vendored XSD

safety.sandbox_or_scope: Write only inside the generated package root; source references must be relative and traversal-free.

verification.version_probe: Vendored dh-nunes/fomod-schema ModuleConfig.xsd with preserved MIT license
verification.output_readback: Reload XML, validate ModuleConfig against pinned XSD, and simulate option matrix before packaging.

ai.context_cost_notes: Generate from compact typed intent; do not ask a model to hand-author large XML trees.

evidence.notes: Exact MIT ModuleConfig schema is vendored under third_party/fomod-schema.
